question_sw: Mzee faida ya duka mwezi huu imefika TZS 8,400,000, sasa SDL yangu itakuwa ngapi?
question_en: Boss, the shop profit this month reached TZS 8,400,000, so what will my SDL be?
correct_answer_sw: SDL inatozwa kwa jumla ya mishahara (gross payroll) ya wafanyakazi, siyo faida. Faida ya TZS 8,400,000 haitumiki kukokotoa SDL. Nipe jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi na idadi yao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL is charged on total gross payroll, not profit. The TZS 8,400,000 profit cannot be used to compute SDL. Provide the gross payroll and headcount. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: profit figure (faida) offered as the SDL base

question_sw: Nina mtaji wa TZS 15,000,000 nimeuwekeza kwenye biashara, NSSF yangu naichangiaje kutoka hapo?
question_en: I have TZS 15,000,000 capital invested in the business, how do I contribute NSSF from that?
correct_answer_sw: NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi wa kila mfanyakazi (jumla 20% mwajiri na mfanyakazi), siyo asilimia ya mtaji. Mtaji wa TZS 15,000,000 hauhusiki. Nipe mshahara wa mwezi wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: NSSF is 10% of each employee gross wage (20% total), not a percentage of capital. The TZS 15,000,000 capital is irrelevant. Provide the monthly wage. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: capital (mtaji) offered as the NSSF base

question_sw: Nimechukua deni la benki TZS 6,700,000 kwa ajili ya biashara, hii inaongeza SDL yangu kiasi gani?
question_en: I took a TZS 6,700,000 bank loan for the business, how much does this add to my SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Deni la benki halihusiani na SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi tu. Deni la TZS 6,700,000 halitozwi SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: A bank loan is unrelated to SDL. SDL is 3.5% of total employee payroll only. The TZS 6,700,000 loan is not subject to SDL. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: bank loan (deni) offered as the SDL base

question_sw: Bei ya soko ya duka langu ni TZS 25,000,000, WCF nailipa kutokana na thamani hiyo?
question_en: My shop market value is TZS 25,000,000, do I pay WCF based on that value?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara (gross cash emoluments) ya wafanyakazi, siyo thamani ya soko ya duka. Bei ya TZS 25,000,000 haitumiki. Nipe jumla ya mishahara. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. WCF is 0.5% of total employee gross emoluments, not the shop market value. The TZS 25,000,000 value is not used. Provide the payroll. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: market value (bei ya soko) offered as the WCF base

question_sw: Mzunguko wa fedha (cash flow) wa biashara ni TZS 9,000,000 kwa mwezi, PAYE inakatwa vipi hapo?
question_en: My business cash turnover is TZS 9,000,000 a month, how is PAYE deducted from that?
correct_answer_sw: PAYE haikatwi kutoka mzunguko wa fedha wa biashara. PAYE hukatwa kutoka mshahara wa kila mfanyakazi kwa mabano (0% hadi TZS 270,000, kisha 8%, 20%, 25%, 30%). Nipe mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: PAYE is not deducted from business turnover. PAYE is deducted from each employee salary using the bands. Provide the salary. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: turnover/cash flow offered as the PAYE base

question_sw: Thamani ya hisa za kampuni yangu ni TZS 4,500,000, nawezaje kupata SDL kutoka humo?
question_en: My company share value is TZS 4,500,000, how do I get SDL from that?
correct_answer_sw: Thamani ya hisa haihusiani na SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Thamani ya hisa TZS 4,500,000 haitumiki. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Share value is unrelated to SDL. SDL is 3.5% of employee payroll. The TZS 4,500,000 share value is not used. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: share value (thamani ya hisa) offered as the SDL base

question_sw: Mapato ya biashara yangu yalifika TZS 12,300,000 mwezi jana, NSSF ya jumla ni ngapi?
question_en: My business income reached TZS 12,300,000 last month, what is the total NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: NSSF haikokotwi kutoka mapato ya biashara. NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi wa mfanyakazi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Mapato ya TZS 12,300,000 hayahusiki. Nipe mshahara na idadi ya wafanyakazi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: NSSF is not computed from business income. NSSF is 20% of employee gross wage. The TZS 12,300,000 income is irrelevant. Provide wages and headcount. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: business income (mapato) offered as the NSSF base

question_sw: Nalipa kodi ya pango TZS 850,000 kwa mwezi kwa ofisi, hii inaingia kwenye hesabu ya SDL?
question_en: I pay office rent of TZS 850,000 a month, does this go into the SDL calculation?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kodi ya pango si sehemu ya mishahara, kwa hiyo haiingii kwenye SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi pekee. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. Rent is not part of payroll, so it does not enter SDL. SDL is 3.5% of employee payroll only. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: rent expense (kodi ya pango) offered as SDL input

question_sw: Magari yangu ya biashara yana thamani ya TZS 40,000,000 kwa jumla, WCF yake naikadiriaje?
question_en: My business vehicles are worth TZS 40,000,000 in total, how do I estimate their WCF?
correct_answer_sw: WCF haitozwi kwa thamani ya magari. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Thamani ya magari TZS 40,000,000 haihusiki. Nipe jumla ya mishahara. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: WCF is not charged on vehicle value. WCF is 0.5% of employee payroll. The TZS 40,000,000 vehicle value is irrelevant. Provide payroll. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: fleet value offered as the WCF base

question_sw: Nina akiba ya benki TZS 3,300,000, naweza kuitumia kulipa NSSF ya mfanyakazi mmoja?
question_en: I have TZS 3,300,000 bank savings, can I use it to compute one employee NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Akiba ya benki haitumiki kukokotoa NSSF. NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara wake wa mwezi. Nipe mshahara wa mfanyakazi, siyo akiba. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Bank savings are not used to compute NSSF. Employee NSSF is 10% of the monthly wage. Provide the wage, not savings. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: bank savings offered as the NSSF base

question_sw: Gharama za umeme mwezi huu ni TZS 1,200,000, je zinabadilisha kiasi cha SDL ninachodaiwa?
question_en: Electricity cost this month is TZS 1,200,000, does it change the SDL I owe?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Gharama za umeme si mishahara, hazibadilishi SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. Electricity cost is not payroll and does not change SDL. SDL is 3.5% of employee payroll. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: utility cost offered as SDL input

question_sw: Faida halisi ya biashara ni TZS 720,000 mwezi huu, PAYE yake ni kiasi gani?
question_en: The net business profit is TZS 720,000 this month, what is its PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: PAYE haikokotwi kutoka faida ya biashara — inakatwa kutoka mshahara wa mfanyakazi. Faida ya TZS 720,000 si mshahara. Nipe mshahara wa mfanyakazi ili nihesabu PAYE. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: PAYE is not computed from business profit — it is deducted from an employee salary. The TZS 720,000 profit is not a salary. Provide the salary. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: net profit (720k looks salary-sized) offered as PAYE base

question_sw: Nimetoa invoice 450 mwezi huu, sasa NSSF yangu itakuwaje?
question_en: I issued 450 invoices this month, so what will my NSSF be?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya invoice (450) haihusiani na NSSF na si kiasi cha fedha. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi wa mfanyakazi. Nipe mshahara wa mwezi, siyo idadi ya invoice. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The invoice count (450) is unrelated to NSSF and is not a money amount. NSSF is 10% of the employee gross wage. Provide the monthly wage. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: 450 = invoice count, not a TZS figure

question_sw: Duka langu linatoa risiti 780 kwa mwezi, SDL inayohusiana na hizo ni ngapi?
question_en: My shop issues 780 receipts a month, what SDL relates to those?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya risiti (780) si mishahara wala kiasi cha fedha, haihusiani na SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The receipt count (780) is neither payroll nor a money amount and is unrelated to SDL. SDL is 3.5% of employee payroll. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: 780 = receipt count

question_sw: Nina matawi 6 nchini kote, PAYE ya wafanyakazi wangu naipataje kutoka idadi hiyo?
question_en: I have 6 branches nationwide, how do I get my employees PAYE from that number?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya matawi (6) haitoi PAYE. PAYE hukatwa kwa kila mfanyakazi kutokana na mshahara wake kwa mwezi kwa mabano. Nipe mshahara wa kila mfanyakazi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The branch count (6) does not yield PAYE. PAYE is deducted per employee from the monthly salary using the bands. Provide each salary. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: 6 = branch count offered for a salary computation

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina magari 14, WCF inahesabiwa kwa kila gari?
question_en: My company has 14 vehicles, is WCF calculated per vehicle?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. WCF haitegemei idadi ya magari (14). WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi. Nipe jumla ya mishahara. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. WCF does not depend on the vehicle count (14). WCF is 0.5% of employee payroll. Provide the payroll. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: 14 = vehicle count

question_sw: Mfanyakazi alifanya kazi siku 26 mwezi huu, NSSF yake ni kiasi gani basi?
question_en: The employee worked 26 days this month, so what is their NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya siku (26) si mshahara. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi wa mwezi wa mfanyakazi. Nihitaji mshahara wa mwezi, siyo idadi ya siku. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The day count (26) is not a wage. NSSF is 10% of the monthly gross wage. I need the monthly wage, not the number of days. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: 26 = days worked

question_sw: Nina wateja 1,500 kwa mwezi, je hii inanifanya nilazimike kusajili VAT?
question_en: I have 1,500 customers a month, does this force me to register for VAT?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kizingiti cha VAT hakitegemei idadi ya wateja (1,500) bali mauzo/mapato: TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Nipe mapato yako, siyo idadi ya wateja. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. The VAT threshold does not depend on customer count (1,500) but on turnover: TZS 200,000,000 a year or TZS 100,000,000 in 6 months. Provide turnover. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: 1,500 = customer count vs VAT turnover threshold

question_sw: Nimefunga mashine 9 mpya za uzalishaji, SDL yangu itapanda kwa kiasi gani?
question_en: I installed 9 new production machines, by how much will my SDL rise?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya mashine (9) haihusiani na SDL. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi tu, si vifaa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The machine count (9) is unrelated to SDL. SDL is 3.5% of employee payroll only, not equipment. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: 9 = machine count

question_sw: Tunaendesha zamu 3 kwa siku kiwandani, NSSF ya jumla kwa zamu hizo ni ngapi?
question_en: We run 3 shifts a day at the factory, what is the total NSSF for those shifts?
correct_answer_sw: Idadi ya zamu (3) si mshahara wala idadi ya wafanyakazi inayotosha kukokotoa. NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi. Nipe idadi ya wafanyakazi na mshahara wao. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The shift count (3) is not a wage nor sufficient headcount to compute. NSSF is 20% of gross wage. Provide headcount and wages. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: 3 = shift count

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu analipwa dola 500 za Marekani kwa mwezi, NSSF yake ni ngapi?
question_en: My employee is paid USD 500 a month, what is their NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara umetajwa kwa dola za Marekani (USD 500), siyo shilingi. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara wa TZS. Lazima ubadilishe USD 500 kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha ubadilishaji cha siku kabla ya kukokotoa. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The wage is stated in US dollars (USD 500), not shillings. NSSF is 10% of the TZS wage. You must convert USD 500 to TZS at the day rate before computing. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: USD-denominated wage needs FX conversion

question_sw: Analipwa euro 400 kila mwezi, PAYE yake naihesabuje kwa mabano ya Tanzania?
question_en: They are paid EUR 400 monthly, how do I compute their PAYE on the Tanzanian bands?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara umetajwa kwa euro (EUR 400). Mabano ya PAYE hutumia shilingi za Tanzania. Badilisha EUR 400 kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha siku kwanza, kisha tumia mabano (0% hadi 270,000, n.k.). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The wage is in euros (EUR 400). PAYE bands use Tanzanian shillings. Convert EUR 400 to TZS at the day rate first, then apply the bands. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: EUR-denominated wage needs FX conversion

question_sw: Wafanyakazi wangu wa mpakani nawalipa shilingi za Kenya 45,000 kila mmoja, SDL yao ni ngapi?
question_en: My border staff are paid KES 45,000 each, what is their SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Kiasi kimetajwa kwa shilingi za Kenya (KES 45,000), siyo shilingi za Tanzania. SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara kwa TZS. Badilisha KES kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha siku, kisha jumlisha mishahara yote. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The amount is in Kenyan shillings (KES 45,000), not Tanzanian. SDL is 3.5% of total TZS payroll. Convert KES to TZS at the day rate, then total the payroll. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: KES (border economy) mistaken for TZS

question_sw: Mfanyakazi analipwa laki saba na nusu tu, NSSF anayokatwa ni ngapi?
question_en: The employee is paid just seven-and-a-half lakh, how much NSSF is deducted?
correct_answer_sw: Laki saba na nusu ni TZS 750,000. NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi: 10% ya TZS 750,000 = TZS 75,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Seven-and-a-half lakh is TZS 750,000. Employee NSSF is 10% of gross: 10% of TZS 750,000 = TZS 75,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: unitless Swahili-word amount (laki saba na nusu = 750,000)

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 12 kila mmoja analipwa dola 300, jumla ya NSSF ya wote ni ngapi?
question_en: I have 12 employees each paid USD 300, what is the total NSSF for all?
correct_answer_sw: Mishahara imetajwa kwa dola (USD 300 kila mmoja). NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara wa TZS. Lazima ubadilishe USD 300 kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha siku kwanza, kisha uzidishe kwa 12 na kwa 20%. Sipati kukokotoa bila kiwango cha ubadilishaji. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Wages are in dollars (USD 300 each). NSSF is 20% of the TZS wage. Convert USD 300 to TZS at the day rate first, then multiply by 12 and 20%. Cannot compute without the FX rate. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: USD wage + count; needs FX before compute

question_sw: Meneja wangu analipwa dola 1,200 kwa mwezi, yuko kwenye kundi gani la PAYE?
question_en: My manager is paid USD 1,200 a month, which PAYE band are they in?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara umetajwa kwa dola (USD 1,200). Makundi ya PAYE hupangwa kwa TZS. Badilisha USD 1,200 kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha siku kwanza; hapo ndipo utaweza kujua kundi (0%/8%/20%/25%/30%). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The wage is in dollars (USD 1,200). PAYE bands are in TZS. Convert USD 1,200 to TZS at the day rate first to determine the band. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: USD wage for a TZS-band lookup

question_sw: Jumla ya kitu tunachotoa kwa wafanyakazi ni pesa 900,000, SDL yake ni ngapi?
question_en: The total we give staff is 900,000 money, what is its SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Kama "pesa 900,000" ni jumla ya mishahara kwa TZS na wafanyakazi ni 10 au zaidi, SDL ni asilimia 3.5: 3.5% ya TZS 900,000 = TZS 31,500. Kama ni chini ya wafanyakazi 10, hakuna SDL. Thibitisha idadi ya wafanyakazi na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: If "900,000 money" is total TZS payroll and there are 10+ employees, SDL is 3.5%: 3.5% of TZS 900,000 = TZS 31,500. If fewer than 10 employees, no SDL. Confirm headcount with TRA.
_why_hard: unitless "pesa" amount + implicit threshold caveat

question_sw: Biashara yangu ilipata shilingi za Kenya 1,200,000 kama mapato, nimefika kizingiti cha VAT?
question_en: My business earned KES 1,200,000 in turnover, have I hit the VAT threshold?
correct_answer_sw: Mapato yametajwa kwa shilingi za Kenya (KES 1,200,000). Kizingiti cha VAT ni TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Badilisha KES kuwa TZS kwa kiwango cha siku kwanza ndipo ulinganishe. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Turnover is in Kenyan shillings (KES 1,200,000). The VAT threshold is TZS 200,000,000/year or TZS 100,000,000/6 months. Convert KES to TZS at the day rate before comparing. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: KES turnover vs TZS VAT threshold

question_sw: Mishahara yetu ni mingi kiasi, lakini jumla hasa ni TZS 3,750,000 kwa wafanyakazi 13 — SDL ni ngapi?
question_en: Our payroll is somewhat large, but the exact total is TZS 3,750,000 for 13 employees — what is the SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Kwa kuwa wafanyakazi ni 13 (zaidi ya 10), SDL inatozwa. Tumia jumla hasa iliyotolewa: asilimia 3.5 ya TZS 3,750,000 = TZS 131,250 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Since there are 13 employees (over 10), SDL applies. Use the exact total given: 3.5% of TZS 3,750,000 = TZS 131,250/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: vague "mingi kiasi" then precise 3,750,000

question_sw: Tuna wafanyakazi wengi sana karibu, lakini hasa ni 18 wenye mshahara wa TZS 480,000 kila mmoja — NSSF ya wote?
question_en: We have very many staff nearly, but exactly 18 at TZS 480,000 each — NSSF for all?
correct_answer_sw: Tumia takwimu hasa: 18 x TZS 480,000 = TZS 8,640,000 jumla ya mishahara. NSSF ni asilimia 20 (mwajiri + mfanyakazi) = TZS 1,728,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Use the exact figures: 18 x TZS 480,000 = TZS 8,640,000 total payroll. NSSF is 20% (employer + employee) = TZS 1,728,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: vague "wengi sana" then precise 18 x 480,000

question_sw: Mshahara wake ni mkubwa kidogo, unafika TZS 920,000 hivi — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
question_en: Their salary is a bit large, reaching about TZS 920,000 — what is their PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: Tumia TZS 920,000. Iko kwenye kundi la nne: PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% ya (920,000 - 760,000) = 68,000 + 40,000 = TZS 108,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Use TZS 920,000. It falls in band 4: PAYE = TZS 68,000 + 25% of (920,000 - 760,000) = 68,000 + 40,000 = TZS 108,000/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: "mkubwa kidogo" then precise 920,000

question_sw: Analipwa mshahara wa wastani, yaani TZS 640,000 — NSSF yake anayokatwa ni ngapi?
question_en: They are paid an average salary, that is TZS 640,000 — how much NSSF is deducted?
correct_answer_sw: Tumia TZS 640,000. NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 = TZS 64,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Use TZS 640,000. Employee NSSF is 10% = TZS 64,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: "wastani" then precise 640,000

question_sw: Kama kawaida mishahara inabadilika, mwezi huu ni TZS 5,200,000 kwa watu 16 — SDL yake?
question_en: As usual payroll varies, this month it is TZS 5,200,000 for 16 people — its SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Watu 16 ni zaidi ya 10, hivyo SDL inatozwa. Tumia jumla hasa: asilimia 3.5 ya TZS 5,200,000 = TZS 182,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: 16 people is over 10, so SDL applies. Use the exact total: 3.5% of TZS 5,200,000 = TZS 182,000/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: "inabadilika" then precise 5,200,000 / 16

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata kama laki sita hivi, sawa TZS 610,000 kamili — PAYE yake ni ngapi?
question_en: The employee gets about six lakh, exactly TZS 610,000 — what is their PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: Tumia TZS 610,000 (kundi la tatu): PAYE = TZS 20,000 + 20% ya (610,000 - 520,000) = 20,000 + 18,000 = TZS 38,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
_why_hard: "kama laki sita hivi" then precise 610,000

question_sw: Robo ya wafanyakazi 24 wanapata TZS 800,000, wengine wote TZS 350,000 — SDL ya jumla?
question_en: A quarter of 24 employees get TZS 800,000, the rest TZS 350,000 — total SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Robo ya 24 ni 6 (kwa TZS 800,000) na 18 (kwa TZS 350,000). Jumla: 6 x 800,000 + 18 x 350,000 = 4,800,000 + 6,300,000 = TZS 11,100,000. Watu 24 zaidi ya 10, SDL = 3.5% = TZS 388,500 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: A quarter of 24 is 6 (at TZS 800,000) and 18 (at TZS 350,000). Total: 6 x 800,000 + 18 x 350,000 = TZS 11,100,000. 24 people over 10, SDL = 3.5% = TZS 388,500/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: fraction split (1/4, 3/4) of 24 employees

question_sw: Watu 5 wanapata 700,000, watu 4 wanapata 550,000, watu 6 wanapata 300,000 — NSSF ya jumla ni ngapi?
question_en: Five get 700,000, four get 550,000, six get 300,000 — what is total NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 5 x 700,000 + 4 x 550,000 + 6 x 300,000 = 3,500,000 + 2,200,000 + 1,800,000 = TZS 7,500,000. NSSF ni asilimia 20 = TZS 1,500,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Total payroll: 5 x 700,000 + 4 x 550,000 + 6 x 300,000 = TZS 7,500,000. NSSF is 20% = TZS 1,500,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: three distinct pay groups

question_sw: Theluthi mbili ya watu 30 wanalipwa TZS 500,000, wengine wanalipwa TZS 900,000 — SDL?
question_en: Two-thirds of 30 people are paid TZS 500,000, the rest TZS 900,000 — SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Theluthi mbili ya 30 ni 20 (kwa 500,000) na 10 (kwa 900,000). Jumla: 20 x 500,000 + 10 x 900,000 = 10,000,000 + 9,000,000 = TZS 19,000,000. Watu 30 zaidi ya 10, SDL = 3.5% = TZS 665,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Two-thirds of 30 is 20 (at 500,000) and 10 (at 900,000). Total: TZS 19,000,000. 30 people over 10, SDL = 3.5% = TZS 665,000/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: fraction (2/3) split of 30

question_sw: Robo tatu ya wafanyakazi 16 wanapata TZS 450,000, robo wanapata TZS 1,000,000 — WCF ya jumla?
question_en: Three-quarters of 16 employees get TZS 450,000, a quarter get TZS 1,000,000 — total WCF?
correct_answer_sw: Robo tatu ya 16 ni 12 (kwa 450,000) na 4 (kwa 1,000,000). Jumla: 12 x 450,000 + 4 x 1,000,000 = 5,400,000 + 4,000,000 = TZS 9,400,000. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 = TZS 47,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Three-quarters of 16 is 12 (at 450,000) and 4 (at 1,000,000). Total: TZS 9,400,000. WCF is 0.5% = TZS 47,000/month. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: fraction (3/4) split, WCF 0.5%

question_sw: Nusu ya wafanyakazi 14 wanapata TZS 620,000, nusu wanapata TZS 380,000 — sehemu ya mwajiri ya NSSF?
question_en: Half of 14 employees get TZS 620,000, half get TZS 380,000 — the employer NSSF share?
correct_answer_sw: Nusu ya 14 ni 7 na 7. Jumla: 7 x 620,000 + 7 x 380,000 = 4,340,000 + 2,660,000 = TZS 7,000,000. Sehemu ya mwajiri ni asilimia 10 = TZS 700,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Half of 14 is 7 and 7. Total: TZS 7,000,000. Employer share is 10% = TZS 700,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: half/half split of 14, employer 10%

question_sw: Watu 3 wa kwanza wanapata TZS 1,200,000, wanne wanaofuata TZS 800,000, watano wa mwisho TZS 500,000 — SDL?
question_en: The first 3 get TZS 1,200,000, the next four TZS 800,000, the last five TZS 500,000 — SDL?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 3 x 1,200,000 + 4 x 800,000 + 5 x 500,000 = 3,600,000 + 3,200,000 + 2,500,000 = TZS 9,300,000. Wafanyakazi 12 (zaidi ya 10), SDL = 3.5% = TZS 325,500 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Total payroll: 3 x 1,200,000 + 4 x 800,000 + 5 x 500,000 = TZS 9,300,000. 12 employees (over 10), SDL = 3.5% = TZS 325,500/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: three ordered pay groups totalling 12

question_sw: Analipwa TZS 320,000 kila wiki mbili (bi-weekly), NSSF yake ya mwezi ni ngapi?
question_en: They are paid TZS 320,000 every two weeks (bi-weekly), what is their monthly NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Malipo ni ya kila wiki mbili, hivyo nihitaji mshahara halisi wa mwezi kwanza (mfano malipo mawili kwa mwezi ni TZS 640,000, lakini hii inategemea kalenda). Toa mshahara wa mwezi ndipo nikokotoe NSSF (10% ya mfanyakazi). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Pay is bi-weekly, so I first need the actual monthly gross (e.g. two pays a month is TZS 640,000, but this depends on the calendar). Provide the monthly wage, then I compute NSSF (10% employee). Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: bi-weekly -> monthly is not a clean multiple

question_sw: Vibarua wanalipwa TZS 25,000 kwa zamu, zamu 3 kwa siku — NSSF yao naihesabuje?
question_en: Casual workers are paid TZS 25,000 per shift, 3 shifts a day — how do I compute their NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Malipo ni kwa zamu. Nihitaji jumla ya mshahara wa mwezi wa kila mfanyakazi (idadi ya zamu kwa mwezi x TZS 25,000) kabla ya kutoza NSSF (20% ya jumla). Toa jumla ya mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Pay is per shift. I need each worker monthly total (shifts per month x TZS 25,000) before charging NSSF (20% of gross). Provide the monthly total. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: per-shift pay needs monthly aggregation

question_sw: Fundi analipwa TZS 1,500 kwa kipande, anatengeneza vipande 400 kwa mwezi — PAYE yake?
question_en: An artisan is paid TZS 1,500 per piece, makes 400 pieces a month — their PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara wa mwezi = 1,500 x 400 = TZS 600,000. Iko kwenye kundi la tatu: PAYE = TZS 20,000 + 20% ya (600,000 - 520,000) = 20,000 + 16,000 = TZS 36,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Monthly wage = 1,500 x 400 = TZS 600,000. Band 3: PAYE = TZS 20,000 + 20% of (600,000 - 520,000) = 20,000 + 16,000 = TZS 36,000/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: per-piece pay x count -> monthly, then bands

question_sw: Dereva analipwa TZS 80,000 kwa safari, anafanya safari 15 kwa mwezi — SDL inahesabuje?
question_en: A driver is paid TZS 80,000 per trip, does 15 trips a month — how is SDL computed?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara wa dereva kwa mwezi ni 80,000 x 15 = TZS 1,200,000. Lakini SDL hutozwa kwa JUMLA ya mishahara ya wafanyakazi WOTE na tu kama ni 10 au zaidi. Nipe idadi ya wafanyakazi wote na mishahara yao. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The driver monthly wage is 80,000 x 15 = TZS 1,200,000. But SDL is charged on TOTAL payroll of ALL staff and only if 10+. Provide the full headcount and their wages. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: per-trip pay + missing total headcount for SDL

question_sw: Muuzaji analipwa kwa kamisheni, asilimia 5 ya alichouza mwezi — NSSF yake ni ngapi?
question_en: A salesperson is paid on commission, 5% of what they sold that month — their NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara wa kamisheni hubadilika kila mwezi. NSSF ni asilimia 10 ya mshahara ghafi halisi aliopata. Nihitaji kiasi halisi cha kamisheni cha mwezi husika (TZS) ndipo nikokotoe. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Commission pay varies monthly. NSSF is 10% of the actual gross earned. I need the actual monthly commission amount (TZS) to compute. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: commission-based variable pay

question_sw: Analipwa TZS 18,000 kwa siku, anafanya kazi siku 26 kwa mwezi — NSSF yake ya mwezi?
question_en: They are paid TZS 18,000 a day, work 26 days a month — their monthly NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara wa mwezi = 18,000 x 26 = TZS 468,000. NSSF ya mfanyakazi ni asilimia 10 = TZS 46,800 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Monthly wage = 18,000 x 26 = TZS 468,000. Employee NSSF is 10% = TZS 46,800/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: daily rate x days -> monthly, then 10%

question_sw: Kama nilivyokuambia jana, mishahara ile ile — sasa SDL ni ngapi?
question_en: As I told you yesterday, the same payroll — so what is the SDL now?
correct_answer_sw: Sina taarifa ya mazungumzo ya jana; sikumbuki mishahara "ile ile". Tafadhali niambie tena jumla ya mishahara ya mwezi na idadi ya wafanyakazi ndipo nikokotoe SDL (3.5% ikiwa ni wafanyakazi 10+). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: I have no record of yesterday chat; I do not recall the "same" payroll. Please restate the monthly payroll and headcount so I can compute SDL (3.5% if 10+ staff). Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: "jana" reference with no resolvable figure

question_sw: Tumia idadi ya wafanyakazi niliyokupa kwenye ujumbe uliopita, NSSF ya jumla ni ngapi?
question_en: Use the headcount I gave you in the previous message, what is total NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Sina ujumbe uliopita wenye idadi ya wafanyakazi wala mishahara yao. Tafadhali niandikie tena idadi na mshahara wa kila mfanyakazi ndipo nikokotoe NSSF (20% ya jumla). Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: I do not have a previous message with the headcount or wages. Please resend the count and each wage so I can compute NSSF (20% of gross). Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: "ujumbe uliopita" reference, no context

question_sw: Ile hesabu ya wiki iliyopita ya PAYE, ongeza tu asilimia kumi juu yake — jibu jipya ni ngapi?
question_en: Last week PAYE figure, just add ten percent on it — what is the new answer?
correct_answer_sw: Sina hesabu ya PAYE ya wiki iliyopita; sikumbuki kiasi cha awali. Nipe mshahara wa mwezi wa mfanyakazi upya ndipo nikokotoe PAYE kwa mabano rasmi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: I have no last-week PAYE figure; I do not recall the prior amount. Provide the monthly salary again so I compute PAYE from the official bands. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: references an unrecalled prior computation

question_sw: Wale wafanyakazi tuliozungumza asubuhi, WCF yao ni kiasi gani sasa?
question_en: Those workers we discussed this morning, what is their WCF now?
correct_answer_sw: Sina kumbukumbu ya mazungumzo ya asubuhi wala mishahara ya "wale" wafanyakazi. Tafadhali niambie jumla ya mishahara ndipo nikokotoe WCF (0.5% ya jumla ya mishahara). Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: I have no memory of the morning chat or those workers wages. Please tell me the total payroll so I compute WCF (0.5% of gross payroll). Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: "asubuhi" reference, no resolvable payroll

question_sw: Payroll yetu ni TZS 7,000,000 kwa mwezi, sasa je tunatakiwa kujisajili BRELA?
question_en: Our payroll is TZS 7,000,000 a month, so are we required to register with BRELA?
correct_answer_sw: Usajili wa BRELA hautegemei kiasi cha payroll. Kila kampuni au jina la biashara linalofanya biashara Tanzania linatakiwa kusajiliwa BRELA bila kujali mishahara. TZS 7,000,000 haihusiki na uamuzi huo. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: BRELA registration does not depend on payroll size. Every company or business name trading in Tanzania must register regardless of wages. The TZS 7,000,000 is irrelevant. Confirm with BRELA.
_why_hard: RC-5: payroll figure inside a BRELA yes/no, must not route to compute

question_sw: Tuna wafanyakazi 15 wenye mshahara wa TZS 600,000 kila mmoja, je tunahitaji kusajili VAT?
question_en: We have 15 employees at TZS 600,000 each, do we need to register for VAT?
correct_answer_sw: Usajili wa VAT hautegemei idadi ya wafanyakazi wala mishahara, bali mauzo/mapato: TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. Wafanyakazi 15 na mshahara TZS 600,000 hazihusiki. Nipe mapato ya biashara. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: VAT registration depends on turnover (TZS 200,000,000/year or 100,000,000/6 months), not headcount or wages. The 15 employees at 600,000 are irrelevant. Provide turnover. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: RC-5: payroll numbers inside a VAT-registration yes/no

question_sw: Mshahara wangu ni TZS 900,000, sasa kodi ya majengo (property tax) ninayolipa ni ngapi?
question_en: My salary is TZS 900,000, so how much property tax do I pay?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, kodi ya majengo (property tax) iko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu, ambayo inashughulikia kodi za mishahara na biashara (PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, VAT, BRELA, OSHA, GN487A). Tafadhali thibitisha na TRA au mamlaka ya serikali za mitaa (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Sorry, property tax is outside my scope, which covers payroll and business taxes. Please confirm with TRA or the local government authority.
_why_hard: property tax is OOC; salary is a distractor

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 20 na mtaji wa TZS 50,000,000, je nasajili kampuni au jina la biashara BRELA?
question_en: I have 20 staff and TZS 50,000,000 capital, do I register a company or a business name at BRELA?
correct_answer_sw: Uchaguzi kati ya kampuni (company) na jina la biashara (business name) hautegemei idadi ya wafanyakazi wala mtaji, bali muundo wa kisheria unaotaka. Idadi 20 na mtaji TZS 50,000,000 hazihusiki. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Choosing between a company and a business name does not depend on headcount or capital but on the legal structure you want. The 20 staff and 50,000,000 capital are irrelevant. Confirm with BRELA.
_why_hard: structural BRELA question with compute-looking numbers

question_sw: Kiwango cha SDL ni ngapi kwa mtu mwenye mshahara wa TZS 480,000?
question_en: What is the SDL rate for someone earning TZS 480,000?
correct_answer_sw: Kiwango cha SDL ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara — hakibadiliki kwa mshahara wa mtu mmoja. Kwa TZS 480,000 pekee, SDL siyo per-mtu; hutozwa kwa jumla ya mishahara ya wote na tu kama ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The SDL rate is 3.5% of total payroll — it does not change per individual salary. SDL is not per-person; it is on total payroll and only if 10+ employees. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: rate question with embedded salary; answer is the rate, not a computation

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wangu analipwa TZS 1,500,000, sasa faida ya mtaji (capital gains) yangu inatozwaje?
question_en: My employee is paid TZS 1,500,000, so how is my capital gains taxed?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, kodi ya faida ya mtaji (capital gains tax) iko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu. Mshahara wa TZS 1,500,000 hauhusiani na swali hilo. Tafadhali thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Sorry, capital gains tax is outside my scope. The TZS 1,500,000 wage is unrelated. Please confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: capital gains OOC with salary distractor

question_sw: Tuna mishahara ya TZS 4,000,000, je hii inatuweka kwenye kundi la kulipa ushuru wa forodha (import duty)?
question_en: We have payroll of TZS 4,000,000, does this put us in an import duty bracket?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, ushuru wa forodha (import duty) iko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu na hautegemei mishahara. Tafadhali thibitisha na TRA au Mamlaka ya Forodha (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Sorry, import duty is outside my scope and does not depend on payroll. Please confirm with TRA / Customs.
_why_hard: import duty OOC with payroll distractor

question_sw: Je, kama nina wafanyakazi 8 tu, bado nalazimika kulipa NSSF?
question_en: If I only have 8 employees, am I still required to pay NSSF?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. NSSF haina kizingiti cha chini cha wafanyakazi — inahusu mwajiri kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Wafanyakazi 8 wanahusika kikamilifu. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes. NSSF has no minimum employee threshold — it applies from the first employee. The 8 employees are fully covered. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: count 8 could trip compute; real question is NSSF applicability

question_sw: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi ni TZS 300,000, je kujiunga na NSSF ni hiari au lazima?
question_en: The wage is TZS 300,000, is joining NSSF optional or mandatory?
correct_answer_sw: NSSF ni lazima, siyo hiari, kwa waajiri na wafanyakazi wanaostahili — bila kujali mshahara. TZS 300,000 haibadilishi hilo. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: NSSF is mandatory, not optional, for eligible employers and employees regardless of wage. The TZS 300,000 does not change that. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: salary distractor on an NSSF mandatory/optional yes/no

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 6 na mishahara ya TZS 2,400,000, je nalazimika kusajili mahali pa kazi na OSHA?
question_en: I have 6 staff and payroll TZS 2,400,000, must I register the workplace with OSHA?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA inahusu maeneo yote ya kazi bila kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Wafanyakazi 6 na payroll TZS 2,400,000 hazibadilishi wajibu huo. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes. OSHA covers all workplaces with no employee-count threshold. The 6 staff and TZS 2,400,000 do not change the obligation. Confirm with OSHA.
_why_hard: payroll figures on an OSHA applicability yes/no

question_sw: Nina mfanyakazi mmoja tu anayelipwa TZS 500,000, je bado nachangia WCF?
question_en: I have just one employee paid TZS 500,000, do I still contribute WCF?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo. WCF inahusu waajiri wote kutoka mfanyakazi wa kwanza — hakuna kizingiti cha chini. Kwa mfanyakazi mmoja wa TZS 500,000, WCF ni asilimia 0.5 = TZS 2,500 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes. WCF applies to all employers from the first employee — no minimum. For one employee at TZS 500,000, WCF is 0.5% = TZS 2,500/month. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: single-employee applicability + small compute

question_sw: Nimeuza kiwanja kwa TZS 80,000,000, ushuru wa stempu (stamp duty) wa uhamisho ni ngapi?
question_en: I sold a plot for TZS 80,000,000, what is the stamp duty on the transfer?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, ushuru wa stempu (stamp duty) wa uhamisho wa mali iko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu. Tafadhali thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Sorry, stamp duty on property transfer is outside my scope. Please confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: stamp duty OOC with a large TZS figure

question_sw: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi 30 wa mgodi, mrabaha (mining royalty) wa dhahabu tunaotoa ni asilimia ngapi?
question_en: My company has 30 mine workers, what percentage gold royalty do we pay?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, mrabaha wa madini (mining royalties) uko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu. Idadi ya wafanyakazi 30 haihusiani. Tafadhali thibitisha na TRA au Tume ya Madini (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Sorry, mining royalties are outside my scope. The 30 workers are irrelevant. Please confirm with TRA / the Mining Commission.
_why_hard: mining royalty OOC with a headcount distractor

question_sw: Kiwango cha jumla cha NSSF ni asilimia ngapi kwa mfanyakazi mwenye mshahara wa TZS 950,000?
question_en: What is the total NSSF percentage for an employee earning TZS 950,000?
correct_answer_sw: Kiwango cha jumla cha NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi) — hakibadiliki kwa mshahara. Kwa TZS 950,000, jumla ni TZS 190,000 ikitakiwa. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The total NSSF rate is 20% of gross (10% employer + 10% employee) — it does not change with salary. For TZS 950,000 that is TZS 190,000 if requested. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: rate question with embedded salary; answer is the 20% rate

question_sw: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwa huduma ni asilimia ngapi kwa ankara ya TZS 3,000,000?
question_en: What is the VAT withholding rate on services for a TZS 3,000,000 invoice?
correct_answer_sw: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwa huduma ni asilimia 6 (bidhaa ni 3%) — hakitegemei ukubwa wa ankara. Kwa ankara ya TZS 3,000,000, kiasi ni TZS 180,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: The VAT withholding rate on services is 6% (goods are 3%) — it does not depend on invoice size. For a TZS 3,000,000 invoice that is TZS 180,000. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: rate question with embedded invoice amount

question_sw: Duka langu liko Zanzibar na mauzo ni TZS 300,000,000, VAT ya Zanzibar nailipaje?
question_en: My shop is in Zanzibar with turnover TZS 300,000,000, how do I pay Zanzibar VAT?
correct_answer_sw: Samahani, VAT ya Zanzibar inasimamiwa na Mamlaka ya Mapato Zanzibar (ZRA), iko nje ya mada yangu na huduma yangu inayohusu Tanzania Bara. Tafadhali thibitisha na ZRA.
correct_answer_en: Sorry, Zanzibar VAT is administered by the Zanzibar Revenue Authority and is outside my Mainland scope. Please confirm with ZRA.
_why_hard: Zanzibar tax is OOC (Mainland scope); turnover distractor

question_sw: Nina mtaji wa TZS 100,000,000, kama mgeni je naweza kufungua saluni Tanzania?
question_en: I have TZS 100,000,000 capital, as a foreigner can I open a salon in Tanzania?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Chini ya GN 487A, biashara ya saluni ni miongoni mwa shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa wasio raia — bila kujali mtaji. TZS 100,000,000 haibadilishi katazo hilo. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
correct_answer_en: No. Under GN 487A, salon business is among the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens — regardless of capital. The TZS 100,000,000 does not change the ban. Confirm with Immigration.
_why_hard: capital distractor on a GN487A activity-prohibition yes/no

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 11 na mishahara TZS 5,500,000 na nataka kujua SDL na NSSF na pia je nasajili VAT kama mapato ni TZS 205,000,000?
question_en: I have 11 staff and payroll TZS 5,500,000 and want SDL and NSSF and also do I register VAT if turnover is TZS 205,000,000?
correct_answer_sw: Sehemu tatu: (1) SDL: wafanyakazi 11 zaidi ya 10, 3.5% ya TZS 5,500,000 = TZS 192,500. (2) NSSF: 20% ya TZS 5,500,000 = TZS 1,100,000. (3) VAT: mapato TZS 205,000,000 yamevuka kizingiti cha TZS 200,000,000/mwaka, hivyo lazima usajili VAT. Thibitisha na TRA/NSSF.
correct_answer_en: Three parts: (1) SDL: 11 > 10, 3.5% of 5,500,000 = TZS 192,500. (2) NSSF: 20% of 5,500,000 = TZS 1,100,000. (3) VAT: 205,000,000 exceeds the 200,000,000/year threshold, so register. Confirm with TRA/NSSF.
_why_hard: 3 sub-questions chained with na; two computes + one threshold

question_sw: Kama nikizingatia kwamba wafanyakazi wangu, ambao ni 14 wanaopata kila mmoja TZS 500,000, wanastahili NSSF, je jumla ni ngapi na SDL yao pia?
question_en: Considering my staff, who are 14 each earning TZS 500,000, qualify for NSSF, what is the total and their SDL too?
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 14 x TZS 500,000 = TZS 7,000,000. NSSF: 20% = TZS 1,400,000. SDL: wafanyakazi 14 zaidi ya 10, 3.5% ya TZS 7,000,000 = TZS 245,000. Thibitisha na NSSF/TRA.
correct_answer_en: Total payroll: 14 x 500,000 = TZS 7,000,000. NSSF: 20% = TZS 1,400,000. SDL: 14 > 10, 3.5% of 7,000,000 = TZS 245,000. Confirm with NSSF/TRA.
_why_hard: nested relative clause hides the two sub-questions

question_sw: Nilipe SDL, NSSF, PAYE na WCF kwa mfanyakazi mmoja mwenye TZS 800,000 — nionyeshe vyote.
question_en: Compute SDL, NSSF, PAYE and WCF for one employee on TZS 800,000 — show them all.
correct_answer_sw: Kwa mfanyakazi MMOJA wa TZS 800,000: PAYE (kundi 4) = 68,000 + 25% x (800,000-760,000) = TZS 78,000. NSSF mfanyakazi = 10% = TZS 80,000 (jumla 20% = 160,000). WCF = 0.5% = TZS 4,000. SDL: HAKUNA — SDL huanza wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi; mmoja hauzwi SDL. Thibitisha na TRA.
correct_answer_en: For ONE employee on TZS 800,000: PAYE (band 4) = 68,000 + 25% x 40,000 = TZS 78,000. NSSF employee 10% = TZS 80,000 (total 20% = 160,000). WCF 0.5% = TZS 4,000. SDL: NONE — SDL starts at 10+ employees; one is not charged. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: comma-listed four levies; one (SDL) is a zero/not-applicable trap

question_sw: Nina maswali: mishahara ni TZS 3,200,000 kwa watu 8, nataka SDL, NSSF na WCF, na pia je nawajibika kusajili OSHA?
question_en: I have questions: payroll is TZS 3,200,000 for 8 people, I want SDL, NSSF and WCF, and also must I register with OSHA?
correct_answer_sw: SDL: HAKUNA — watu 8 ni chini ya kizingiti cha 10, hivyo hakuna SDL. NSSF: 20% ya TZS 3,200,000 = TZS 640,000. WCF: 0.5% = TZS 16,000. OSHA: Ndiyo, lazima usajili — OSHA haina kizingiti cha idadi. Thibitisha na TRA/NSSF/OSHA.
correct_answer_en: SDL: NONE — 8 people is below the 10 threshold, so no SDL. NSSF: 20% of 3,200,000 = TZS 640,000. WCF: 0.5% = TZS 16,000. OSHA: Yes, must register — no headcount threshold. Confirm with TRA/NSSF/OSHA.
_why_hard: 4-part mix: zero-SDL + two computes + a yes/no

question_sw: Nataka kujua mambo matatu: kwanza kizingiti cha VAT, pili kiwango cha SDL, tatu je nitoe risiti ya EFD kwa muamala wa TZS 5,000?
question_en: I want three things: first the VAT threshold, second the SDL rate, third do I issue an EFD receipt for a TZS 5,000 sale?
correct_answer_sw: (1) Kizingiti cha VAT: TZS 200,000,000 kwa mwaka au TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6. (2) Kiwango cha SDL: asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. (3) EFD: Ndiyo — kila muamala unahitaji risiti ya EFD bila kujali kiasi, hata TZS 5,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: (1) VAT threshold: TZS 200,000,000/year or 100,000,000/6 months. (2) SDL rate: 3.5% of payroll. (3) EFD: Yes — every sale needs an EFD receipt regardless of amount, even TZS 5,000. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: enumerated kwanza/pili/tatu mixing two facts + a yes/no

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata TZS 760,000 na nataka PAYE yake na kama nikiongeza watu wengine 9 kufikia 10, SDL ya jumla ya mishahara ya TZS 7,600,000 itakuwa ngapi?
question_en: An employee earns TZS 760,000 and I want their PAYE and if I add 9 more to reach 10, what is SDL on total payroll of TZS 7,600,000?
correct_answer_sw: PAYE ya TZS 760,000 (kikomo cha kundi 3) = 20,000 + 20% x (760,000-520,000) = TZS 68,000. SDL: ukifikia wafanyakazi 10, sasa inatozwa: 3.5% ya TZS 7,600,000 = TZS 266,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: PAYE on TZS 760,000 (band 3 ceiling) = 20,000 + 20% x 240,000 = TZS 68,000. SDL: at 10 employees it now applies: 3.5% of 7,600,000 = TZS 266,000. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: conditional "if I add 9 to reach 10" hides a threshold-crossing sub-question

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina mishahara TZS 4,800,000 kwa watu 13, na madeni TZS 2,000,000, na faida TZS 1,000,000 — SDL yangu ni ngapi?
question_en: My business has payroll TZS 4,800,000 for 13 people, and debts TZS 2,000,000, and profit TZS 1,000,000 — what is my SDL?
correct_answer_sw: SDL hutozwa kwa mishahara tu. Tumia TZS 4,800,000 (watu 13 zaidi ya 10): 3.5% = TZS 168,000. Madeni TZS 2,000,000 na faida TZS 1,000,000 hazihusiki na SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL is charged on payroll only. Use TZS 4,800,000 (13 people over 10): 3.5% = TZS 168,000. The debts and profit are irrelevant to SDL. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: distractor figures (debt, profit) embedded among the real payroll

question_sw: Swali refu: tuna tawi la Arusha lenye watu 6 wa TZS 400,000 na tawi la Mwanza lenye watu 9 wa TZS 500,000, jumla ya NSSF ya makampuni yote ni ngapi?
question_en: Long one: our Arusha branch has 6 at TZS 400,000 and Mwanza branch has 9 at TZS 500,000, what is total NSSF across all?
correct_answer_sw: Arusha: 6 x 400,000 = 2,400,000. Mwanza: 9 x 500,000 = 4,500,000. Jumla ya mishahara = TZS 6,900,000. NSSF ni 20% = TZS 1,380,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Arusha: 6 x 400,000 = 2,400,000. Mwanza: 9 x 500,000 = 4,500,000. Total payroll = TZS 6,900,000. NSSF 20% = TZS 1,380,000/month. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: two branch sub-totals in a run-on that must be summed

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ni mkazi analipwa TZS 1,100,000 na mwenzake si mkazi analipwa TZS 1,100,000 — PAYE ya kila mmoja ni ngapi?
question_en: A resident earns TZS 1,100,000 and a non-resident colleague earns TZS 1,100,000 — what is each PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: Mkazi (kundi 5): PAYE = 128,000 + 30% x (1,100,000-1,000,000) = TZS 158,000. Asiye mkazi: kiwango cha mkato wa mwisho ni asilimia 15 tambarare = 15% x 1,100,000 = TZS 165,000, siyo mabano. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Resident (band 5): PAYE = 128,000 + 30% x 100,000 = TZS 158,000. Non-resident: flat 15% final withholding = 15% x 1,100,000 = TZS 165,000, not the bands. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: same salary, two tax regimes (resident vs non-resident) in one message

question_sw: Nina wafanyakazi 10, kati yao 4 wana mishahara ya TZS 700,000 na 6 wana TZS 300,000, nataka WCF na SDL — zote mbili.
question_en: I have 10 staff, of whom 4 earn TZS 700,000 and 6 earn TZS 300,000, I want WCF and SDL — both.
correct_answer_sw: Jumla ya mishahara: 4 x 700,000 + 6 x 300,000 = 2,800,000 + 1,800,000 = TZS 4,600,000. WCF: 0.5% = TZS 23,000. SDL: watu 10 wamefikia kizingiti, 3.5% = TZS 161,000. Thibitisha na WCF/TRA.
correct_answer_en: Total payroll: 4 x 700,000 + 6 x 300,000 = TZS 4,600,000. WCF: 0.5% = TZS 23,000. SDL: 10 reaches the threshold, 3.5% = TZS 161,000. Confirm with WCF/TRA.
_why_hard: split pay + two levies; 10 is exactly at threshold

question_sw: Nimenunua bidhaa TZS 10,000,000 na huduma TZS 4,000,000 kutoka msambazaji mmoja — VAT withholding ninayozuia kwa kila kimoja ni ngapi?
question_en: I bought goods TZS 10,000,000 and services TZS 4,000,000 from one supplier — what VAT withholding do I withhold on each?
correct_answer_sw: Bidhaa: 3% x TZS 10,000,000 = TZS 300,000. Huduma: 6% x TZS 4,000,000 = TZS 240,000. Jumla ya kuzuia = TZS 540,000, kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Goods: 3% x 10,000,000 = TZS 300,000. Services: 6% x 4,000,000 = TZS 240,000. Total withheld = TZS 540,000, remitted to TRA by the 20th of the following month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: two withholding rates (goods vs services) must not be conflated

question_sw: Mwezi Januari nilikuwa na watu 9, Februari nikaongeza mmoja kufikia 10, mishahara ni TZS 3,000,000 kila mwezi — SDL ya Januari na Februari?
question_en: In January I had 9 people, in February I added one to reach 10, payroll is TZS 3,000,000 each month — SDL for January and February?
correct_answer_sw: Januari: watu 9 (chini ya 10) — HAKUNA SDL. Februari: watu 10 (wamefikia kizingiti) — SDL = 3.5% ya TZS 3,000,000 = TZS 105,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: January: 9 people (below 10) — NO SDL. February: 10 people (threshold met) — SDL = 3.5% of 3,000,000 = TZS 105,000. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: two time periods, one below and one at threshold (zero + compute)

question_sw: Nataka jibu la haraka: NSSF ya mfanyakazi wa TZS 450,000, na pia deadline ya kuwasilisha, na kama nikichelewa adhabu ni ngapi?
question_en: Quick answer: NSSF for an employee on TZS 450,000, and also the submission deadline, and the penalty if late?
correct_answer_sw: NSSF ya mfanyakazi: 10% ya TZS 450,000 = TZS 45,000. Deadline: mwisho wa mwezi unaofuata mwezi wa mishahara. Adhabu ya kuchelewa: thibitisha kiwango na NSSF (nssf.go.tz) kwani hutofautiana. Thibitisha na NSSF.
correct_answer_en: Employee NSSF: 10% of 450,000 = TZS 45,000. Deadline: end of the month following payroll. Late penalty: confirm the rate with NSSF as it varies. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: compute + deadline + penalty in one message

question_sw: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 9,000,000 kwa mwaka na sina VAT, je nahitaji EFD na kama ndiyo nitoe risiti kwa kila muamala hata wa TZS 500?
question_en: My turnover is TZS 9,000,000 a year and I have no VAT, do I need EFD and if so must I issue a receipt for every sale even TZS 500?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo, unahitaji EFD -- kwa default, bila kujali mauzo yako. Hakuna kizingiti cha mauzo kwa EFD (TZS 9,000,000 haibadilishi jibu). Lazima utoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala, hata wa TZS 500. Msamaha unatolewa TU na TRA kupitia taarifa rasmi inayotaja jina lako au kundi lako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes, you need EFD -- by default, regardless of your turnover. There is no turnover threshold for EFD (TZS 9,000,000 does not change the answer). You must issue an EFD receipt for every sale, even TZS 500. Exemption is only by a TRA public notice naming your specific class. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: conditional "if yes" nested inside a threshold yes/no

question_sw: Kama mgeni je naweza kufanya biashara ya jumla (wholesale) na je adhabu yangu ikikutwa ni ngapi na je raia aliyenisaidia naye anaadhibiwa?
question_en: As a foreigner can I do wholesale and what is my penalty if caught and is the citizen who helped me also punished?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana, biashara ya jumla (wholesale) imezuiliwa kwa wasio raia chini ya GN 487A. Adhabu ya mgeni: faini isiyopungua TZS 10,000,000 na/au kifungo hadi miezi 6 na kufutwa viza. Raia aliyesaidia: faini TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo miezi 3. Thibitisha na Uhamiaji.
correct_answer_en: No, wholesale is prohibited for non-citizens under GN 487A. Non-citizen penalty: fine not less than TZS 10,000,000 and/or up to 6 months and visa revocation. Assisting citizen: TZS 5,000,000 fine or 3 months. Confirm with Immigration.
_why_hard: 3 sub-questions via na: prohibition + two different penalties

question_sw: Mapato yangu ni TZS 120,000,000 katika miezi 6 lakini kwa mwaka mzima ni TZS 190,000,000 — je nasajili VAT na kwa kigezo kipi?
question_en: My turnover is TZS 120,000,000 in 6 months but TZS 190,000,000 for the full year — do I register for VAT and on which test?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo, lazima usajili. Ingawa kigezo cha mwaka (TZS 190,000,000) hakijafikia TZS 200,000,000, kigezo cha miezi 6 (TZS 120,000,000) kimevuka TZS 100,000,000. Kufikia kizingiti chochote kati ya hivyo kunalazimisha usajili. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Yes, you must register. Although the annual figure (TZS 190,000,000) is below 200,000,000, the 6-month figure (120,000,000) exceeds 100,000,000. Meeting either test forces registration. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: two thresholds in tension; the 6-month one triggers

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana mshahara wa msingi TZS 600,000 na posho ya usafiri TZS 150,000 na bonasi ya mara moja TZS 200,000 — PAYE ya mwezi huu?
question_en: An employee has basic TZS 600,000 and transport allowance TZS 150,000 and a one-off bonus TZS 200,000 — PAYE this month?
correct_answer_sw: Mshahara wa jumla unaotozwa (kama posho na bonasi zinahesabika) = 600,000 + 150,000 + 200,000 = TZS 950,000 (kundi 4): PAYE = 68,000 + 25% x (950,000-760,000) = 68,000 + 47,500 = TZS 115,500. Thibitisha aina ya posho na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Taxable gross (if allowance and bonus are chargeable) = 600,000 + 150,000 + 200,000 = TZS 950,000 (band 4): PAYE = 68,000 + 25% x 190,000 = 68,000 + 47,500 = TZS 115,500. Confirm allowance treatment with TRA.
_why_hard: basic + allowance + bonus components must be summed before banding

question_sw: Kiwango cha WCF ni asilimia 3.5 ya mishahara, sivyo?
question_en: The WCF rate is 3.5% of payroll, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Asilimia 3.5 ni kiwango cha SDL, siyo WCF. WCF ni asilimia 0.5 ya jumla ya mishahara. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. 3.5% is the SDL rate, not WCF. WCF is 0.5% of gross payroll. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: WCF 0.5% vs SDL 3.5% collision

question_sw: GN 605A ndiyo inayozuia biashara za wageni Tanzania, sivyo?
question_en: GN 605A is the one that prohibits foreigner businesses in Tanzania, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A ni Amri ya kima cha chini cha mshahara wa sekta binafsi (ilianza 1 Januari 2026). Inayozuia biashara za wasio raia ni GN 487A. Ni Amri mbili tofauti kabisa.
correct_answer_en: No. GN 605A is the private-sector minimum wage order (effective 1 January 2026). The one prohibiting non-citizen businesses is GN 487A. They are two entirely different orders.
_why_hard: GN605A wage order vs GN487A business restriction

question_sw: Kiwango cha mchango wa NSSF ni asilimia 3.5, au ni 0.5?
question_en: Is the NSSF contribution rate 3.5%, or is it 0.5%?
correct_answer_sw: Hakuna. NSSF ni asilimia 20 ya mshahara ghafi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi). Asilimia 3.5 ni SDL na 0.5 ni WCF. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Neither. NSSF is 20% of gross (10% employer + 10% employee). 3.5% is SDL and 0.5% is WCF. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: NSSF 20% vs SDL 3.5% vs WCF 0.5%

question_sw: VAT withholding kwa huduma ni asilimia 18 kama kiwango cha kawaida, sivyo?
question_en: VAT withholding on services is 18% like the standard rate, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Asilimia 18 ni kiwango cha kawaida cha VAT. VAT withholding ni asilimia 6 kwa huduma na asilimia 3 kwa bidhaa (tangu 1 Julai 2025). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. 18% is the standard VAT rate. VAT withholding is 6% on services and 3% on goods (since 1 July 2025). Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: standard 18% vs withholding 6%/3%

question_sw: GN 487A ilianza kutumika Januari 2026, sivyo?
question_en: GN 487A took effect in January 2026, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A ilianza tarehe 28 Julai 2025. Tarehe 1 Januari 2026 ni ya GN 605A (kima cha chini cha mshahara). Thibitisha na Uhamiaji.
correct_answer_en: No. GN 487A took effect on 28 July 2025. 1 January 2026 is GN 605A (minimum wage). Confirm with Immigration.
_why_hard: 487A date (28 Jul 2025) vs 605A date (1 Jan 2026)

question_sw: Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return BRELA ni TZS 2,500, sivyo?
question_en: The BRELA annual return filing fee is TZS 2,500, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. TZS 2,500 ni adhabu ya kuchelewa kwa mwezi (kampuni ya ndani). Ada ya kuwasilisha annual return ni TZS 22,000. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. TZS 2,500 is the monthly late penalty (local company). The annual return filing fee is TZS 22,000. Confirm with BRELA.
_why_hard: BRELA 22,000 fee vs 2,500 late penalty

question_sw: Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 4, sivyo?
question_en: The SDL threshold is 4 employees, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kizingiti cha SDL ni wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi Tanzania Bara. Chini ya 10 hakuna wajibu wa SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. The SDL threshold is 10 or more employees on the Mainland. Below 10 there is no SDL obligation. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: SDL threshold 10 vs the wrong 4

question_sw: Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia 25, sivyo?
question_en: The top PAYE rate is 25%, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Kiwango cha juu kabisa cha PAYE ni asilimia 30 (kwa mapato yanayozidi TZS 1,000,000 kwa mwezi). Asilimia 25 ni kundi la nne. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. The top PAYE rate is 30% (income above TZS 1,000,000/month). 25% is the fourth band. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: top band 30% vs the 25% fourth band

question_sw: Ajali ya kazini WCF lazima itolewe taarifa ndani ya siku 30, sivyo?
question_en: A workplace accident must be reported to WCF within 30 days, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Ajali ya kazini lazima itolewe taarifa WCF ndani ya siku 7 za kazi. Siku 30 ni muda wa mwajiri mpya kujisajili WCF baada ya kuajiri mtu wa kwanza. Thibitisha na WCF (wcf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. A workplace accident must be reported to WCF within 7 working days. 30 days is the new-employer WCF registration window. Confirm with WCF.
_why_hard: accident report 7 working days vs 30-day registration

question_sw: PAYE ya mfanyakazi asiye mkazi ni asilimia 30, sivyo?
question_en: PAYE for a non-resident employee is 30%, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi asiye mkazi hulipa PAYE kwa kiwango tambarare cha asilimia 15 (mkato wa mwisho), siyo mabano wala 30%. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. A non-resident pays PAYE at a flat 15% (final withholding), not the bands or 30%. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: non-resident flat 15% vs resident top 30%

question_sw: SDL inalipwa ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi kama VAT withholding, sivyo?
question_en: SDL is paid by the 20th like VAT withholding, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. SDL inawasilishwa ifikapo siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Tarehe 20 ni ya VAT withholding na return ya VAT. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. SDL is remitted by the 7th of the following month. The 20th is for VAT withholding and the VAT return. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: SDL 7th vs VAT withholding 20th

question_sw: Adhabu ya raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia mgeni chini ya GN 487A ni TZS 10,000,000, sivyo?
question_en: The penalty for a Tanzanian who assists a foreigner under GN 487A is TZS 10,000,000, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. TZS 10,000,000 ni adhabu ya chini kwa mgeni mwenyewe. Raia anayemsaidia hupata faini ya TZS 5,000,000 au kifungo cha miezi 3. Thibitisha na Uhamiaji.
correct_answer_en: No. TZS 10,000,000 is the minimum penalty for the non-citizen. An assisting citizen gets a TZS 5,000,000 fine or 3 months. Confirm with Immigration.
_why_hard: non-citizen 10M vs facilitator 5M

question_sw: Kizingiti cha kuanza kutumia EFD ni mauzo ya TZS 200,000,000, sivyo?
question_en: The EFD threshold is TZS 200,000,000 turnover, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. TZS 200,000,000 ni kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kwa mwaka, si EFD. EFD haina kizingiti cha mauzo kabisa -- inahitajika kwa default kwa kila mfanyabiashara. Msamaha unatolewa TU na TRA kupitia taarifa rasmi inayotaja jina lako au kundi lako maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. TZS 200,000,000 is the annual VAT registration threshold, not EFD's. EFD has no turnover threshold at all -- it is required by default for every business. Exemption is only by a TRA public notice naming your specific class. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: EFD has no threshold at all vs VAT's real 200M

question_sw: NSSF ina mgawanyo mmoja tu wa 10 kwa 10 kati ya mwajiri na mfanyakazi, sivyo?
question_en: NSSF has only one split, 10 and 10 between employer and employee, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. Jumla ni asilimia 20 daima, lakini kuna migawanyo mitatu halali: 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi, au 15% + 5%, au 20% + 0%. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. The total is always 20%, but there are three valid splits: 10%+10%, 15%+5%, or 20%+0%. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: NSSF three valid splits vs single 10+10

question_sw: Kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kwa mwaka mzima ni TZS 100,000,000, sivyo?
question_en: The annual VAT registration threshold is TZS 100,000,000, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. TZS 100,000,000 ni kigezo cha miezi 6. Kizingiti cha mwaka mzima ni TZS 200,000,000. Kufikia chochote kati ya hivyo kunalazimisha usajili. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: No. TZS 100,000,000 is the 6-month test. The annual threshold is TZS 200,000,000. Meeting either forces registration. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: VAT 6-month 100M vs annual 200M confusion

question_sw: Kima cha chini cha mshahara cha GN 605A kilianza kutumika Julai 2025, sivyo?
question_en: The GN 605A minimum wage took effect in July 2025, right?
correct_answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A ilianza kutumika tarehe 1 Januari 2026 (ilitangazwa 13 Oktoba 2025). Julai 2025 ni kipindi cha ongezeko la mshahara wa sekta ya umma, siyo GN 605A ya sekta binafsi. Thibitisha na TanzLII.
correct_answer_en: No. GN 605A took effect on 1 January 2026 (gazetted 13 October 2025). July 2025 relates to the public-sector wage rise, not the GN 605A private-sector order. Confirm via TanzLII.

correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo, halipi mabano. Asiye mkazi hulipa kiwango tambarare cha asilimia 15 (mkato wa mwisho), siyo mabano ya kawaida. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Correct, not the bands. A non-resident pays a flat 15% (final withholding), not the ordinary bands. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: affirming a negative about band applicability

question_sw: Kampuni yenye wafanyakazi 9 haitakiwi kulipa SDL, sivyo?
question_en: A company with 9 employees is not required to pay SDL, right?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo, sivyo — haitakiwi. Wafanyakazi 9 wako chini ya kizingiti cha 10, hivyo hakuna SDL. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Correct — not required. 9 employees is below the 10 threshold, so no SDL. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: confirming a "not required, right?" tag question

question_sw: Je, NSSF si ya hiari kwa mwajiri anayestahili?
question_en: Is NSSF not optional for an eligible employer?
correct_answer_sw: Ndiyo, si ya hiari. NSSF ni lazima kwa mwajiri na wafanyakazi wanaostahili. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Correct, not optional. NSSF is mandatory for eligible employers and employees. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: affirming a negative ("si ya hiari")

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 800,000 — PAYE ni ngapi na mshahara halisi baada ya PAYE ni ngapi?
question_en: Salary is TZS 800,000 — what is PAYE and the net salary after PAYE?
correct_answer_sw: PAYE (kundi 4) = 68,000 + 25% x (800,000-760,000) = TZS 78,000. Mshahara halisi baada ya PAYE = 800,000 - 78,000 = TZS 722,000 (kabla ya makato mengine). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: PAYE (band 4) = 68,000 + 25% x 40,000 = TZS 78,000. Net after PAYE = 800,000 - 78,000 = TZS 722,000 (before other deductions). Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: answer has 78,000 + 722,000; input 800,000 must not alone pass

question_sw: Jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 6,400,000 kwa wafanyakazi 16 — SDL inayostahili ni ngapi?
question_en: Total payroll is TZS 6,400,000 for 16 employees — what SDL is due?
correct_answer_sw: Wafanyakazi 16 zaidi ya 10, SDL = 3.5% ya TZS 6,400,000 = TZS 224,000 kwa mwezi. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: 16 over 10, SDL = 3.5% of TZS 6,400,000 = TZS 224,000/month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: answer 224,000; echoing input 6,400,000 must not pass

question_sw: Nimelipa huduma ya TZS 5,000,000 kwa mtoa huduma aliyesajili VAT — VAT withholding ni ngapi?
question_en: I paid TZS 5,000,000 for a service from a VAT-registered provider — what is the VAT withholding?
correct_answer_sw: VAT withholding kwa huduma ni asilimia 6: 6% ya TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 300,000, kuwasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: VAT withholding on services is 6%: 6% of TZS 5,000,000 = TZS 300,000, remitted by the 20th of the following month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: answer 300,000; input 5,000,000 present as distractor

question_sw: Mshahara ni TZS 700,000 na tumekubaliana mgao wa 15% mwajiri na 5% mfanyakazi — kila upande ni ngapi?
question_en: Salary is TZS 700,000 with an agreed 15% employer / 5% employee split — what is each side?
correct_answer_sw: Sehemu ya mwajiri: 15% ya TZS 700,000 = TZS 105,000. Sehemu ya mfanyakazi: 5% ya TZS 700,000 = TZS 35,000. Jumla bado ni 20% = TZS 140,000. Thibitisha na NSSF (nssf.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: Employer share: 15% of TZS 700,000 = TZS 105,000. Employee share: 5% of TZS 700,000 = TZS 35,000. Total is still 20% = TZS 140,000. Confirm with NSSF.
_why_hard: three answer figures (105,000/35,000/140,000) from the 15+5 split

question_sw: Watu wawili: mmoja anapata TZS 400,000 na mwingine TZS 1,200,000 — PAYE ya kila mmoja ni ngapi?
question_en: Two people: one earns TZS 400,000 and the other TZS 1,200,000 — what is each PAYE?
correct_answer_en: The TZS 400,000 one (band 2): 8% x 130,000 = TZS 10,400. The TZS 1,200,000 one (band 5): 128,000 + 30% x 200,000 = TZS 188,000. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: two salaries + two PAYE answers; cross-matching risk

question_sw: Jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 3,000,000 kwa watu 12 — SDL ni ngapi na inalipwa lini?
question_en: Total payroll is TZS 3,000,000 for 12 people — what is SDL and when is it paid?
correct_answer_sw: SDL = 3.5% ya TZS 3,000,000 = TZS 105,000 (watu 12 zaidi ya 10). Inawasilishwa ifikapo siku ya 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).
correct_answer_en: SDL = 3.5% of TZS 3,000,000 = TZS 105,000 (12 over 10). Remitted by the 7th of the following month. Confirm with TRA.
_why_hard: answer 105,000 + deadline 7; input 3,000,000 distractor
